SELECT home_store_id, count(*) versions, count(DISTINCT member_id) members, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur_rows, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) cur_members, min(valid_from), max(join_date), sum(CASE WHEN join_date>current_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) future_join
FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY home_store_id

WITH m AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur, max(valid_from) lastfrom, max(CASE WHEN valid_to='9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_ended FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id)
SELECT count(*) members, sum(CASE WHEN cur=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_current, sum(CASE WHEN cur>1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) multi_current, sum(CASE WHEN open_ended=1 AND cur=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) open_not_flagged FROM m

SELECT d.home_store_id, count(*) n, min(d.valid_to) mn, max(d.valid_to) mx, min(d.join_date), max(d.join_date) FROM dim_member d WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id HAVING sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)=0) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS tampere_members, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN m.member_id END) AS with_consent, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.store_id=136 THEN m.member_id END) AS lamminpaa, (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id=900 AND is_current) AS online
FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city='Tampere' AND s.store_id<900
